name: Dara
seed: Madger’s mother, alive and living in Reedbank. Taught him that feeding a person creates a relationship, not a debt.
design: Female badger, salt-gray temple fur, warm cream muzzle, berry shawl and river-green apron; distinct from Madger.
history: Raised near Reedbank’s ferries; organized shared meals long before her son imagined a town. Stayed to rebuild after the flood.
desire: To keep a kitchen where asking for food is ordinary, and finally learn a dance she has watched for years.
contradiction: Offers help so quickly that she can miss when someone wants privacy.
relationships: Hollis is her partner; Mara her former helper; Madger her adult son, not her project.
arc: Learns to ask before intervening in Madger’s dispute while holding him responsible for hurtful words.
story_engine: A family visit without an emergency; two rival cooks discover they learned from the same neighbor.
writer_truth: She suspected the rescue had a wealthy backer but did not know Veyra paid.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
